title: Machine learning selects an N-TIMP2 variant with altered MMP specificity
summary: Models trained on binding data for MMP-1, MMP-3 and MMP-9 guided selection of an N-TIMP2 variant. The paper reports high affinity for MMP-9, moderate affinity for MMP-3 and low affinity for MMP-1 relative to wild type. This is an in-vitro protein specificity result, not clinical efficacy. Earlier N-TIMP2 specificity engineering exists, so the new result is limited to the study’s selected variant and its assays.
ai_technology: Machine-learning binding predictors for MMP-1, MMP-3 and MMP-9

evidence.tested: Primary article reports an experimentally tested selected N-TIMP2 variant with differential MMP binding profile.
evidence.unknown: Conference abstract posting/result chronology and exact sequence-level overlap remain unresolved; no clinical claim.
evidence.ai_role: Binding predictors scored mutation candidates and guided selection of variant for experimental binding assays.

source_review.scope: Primary source checked for identity, date, model role and bounded reported result.
